scope: Finite feasibility and source-to-reading equivalence only; no optimality, registration, identity-to-T294 or global novelty claim
pressure_policy: One worker; passive observer; stop if pressure is not 1 or telemetry is stale; normal-pressure swap-disk warning allowed by coordinator
order: two-square positive and refused controls on both routes

controls.name: duplicate-square-overlap
controls.mutation: replace square 2 geometry by square 1, preserve id 2

controls.name: sharp-overlap
controls.mutation: decrease square 2 y by exact 1/10^30; source squares 1 and 2 touch vertically

controls.name: sharp-outside
controls.mutation: decrease square 1 y by exact 1/10^30; source square 1 touches y=0

control_limitation: Controls are exact source-derived two-square fixtures, not complete 179-square negative jobs.
